# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "tmm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Implementation = "tmm-implementation.html",
    Theory = "tmm-theory.html"
  )
)
```

```{r tmm_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "tmm",
  summary = paste(
    "The transition-matrix method (`TMM`) represents a target by the linear map",
    "from incident modal coefficients to scattered modal coefficients. Its",
    "retained state can support more than a monostatic target-strength curve."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Choose a basis matched to the supported geometry, solve the boundary",
    "problem for the coefficient map, and optionally retain its frequency-wise",
    "blocks for angular scattering, orientation averages, and diagnostics",
    "[@Waterman_1969; @Waterman_2009]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Supported single-target canonical geometries requiring retained angular products",
    "Bistatic slices, scattering grids, and orientation post-processing from one solved state",
    "Cross-checking geometry-specific modal families within a transition-matrix representation"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "Sphere, oblate-spheroid, prolate-spheroid, and guarded finite-cylinder branches",
    "Supported fixed-rigid, pressure-release, penetrable, and spherical-shell boundaries",
    "Optional retained T-matrix blocks for branch-specific post-processing"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "A single target represented by one of the documented geometry-specific bases",
    "Homogeneous-region or supported concentric spherical-shell material structure",
    "Post-processing uses the documented body-fixed angular convention",
    "Validation and retained-state support differ by geometry and boundary branch"
  ),
  reading = c(
    "[Implementation](tmm-implementation.html): branch matrix, retained-state workflows, output, 
    and validation",
    "[Theory](tmm-theory.html): coefficient maps, boundary operators, and geometry-matched bases"
  )
)
```
